widgets.description: Top app bar with title, prefix, and suffix widgets. Title takes a Widget, NOT a String.
widgets.parameters: title: Widget?, prefix: Widget?, suffix: Widget?, centerTitle: bool?, titleSpacing: double?, backgroundColor: Color?, automaticallyImplyLeading: bool = true
widgets.example:
TopAppBar(
  title: AppText.bodyLgSemiBold(text: 'Login', textColor: TextColors.colorText),
  prefix: AppIcon(svgIconPath: 'assets/svg/back.svg', onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context)),
  suffix: AppIcon(svgIconPath: 'assets/svg/settings.svg'),
)

widgets.description: Primary filled button. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double, isLoading: bool = false, backgroundColor: Color?, textColor: Color?, borderRadius: BorderRadius?
widgets.example:
AppFilledButton.medium(
  btnText: 'Login',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.defaultButton,
  width: double.infinity,
)

AppFilledButton.large(
  btnText: 'Submit',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.successButton,
  iconPath: 'assets/svg/check.svg',
)

widgets.description: Outlined button for secondary actions. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double, isLoading: bool = false
widgets.example:
AppOutlinedButton.medium(
  btnText: 'Cancel',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.neutralButton,
  width: double.infinity,
)

widgets.description: Text-only button for tertiary actions. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double
widgets.example:
AppTextButton.medium(
  btnText: 'Forgot Password?',
  onTap: () {},
  buttonType: ButtonType.defaultButton,
)

widgets.description: Medium-emphasis tonal button. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: btnText: String? (required if no child), child: Widget?, onTap: VoidCallback?, buttonType: ButtonType = ButtonType.defaultButton, iconPath: String?, suffixIconPath: String?, width: double, isLoading: bool = false

widgets.description: Text input with label, validation, and helper text. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .medium or .large ONLY.
widgets.parameters: labelText: String?, hintText: String?, textEditingController: TextEditingController?, keyboardType: TextInputType?, obscureText: bool = false, readOnly: bool = false, prefix: Widget?, suffix: Widget?, helperText: String?, validator: String? Function(String?)?, width: double = 200, height: double (40 for medium / 56 for large), isOptionalEnabled: bool = false, optionalText: String?, onChanged: Function(String)?
widgets.example:
AppTextField.large(
  labelText: 'Email',
  hintText: 'Enter your email',
  textEditingController: _emailController,
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  width: double.infinity,
)

AppTextField.large(
  labelText: 'Password',
  hintText: 'Enter your password',
  textEditingController: _passwordController,
  obscureText: true,
  width: double.infinity,
)

widgets.description: Typography component. Has PRIVATE default constructor — MUST use named constructors: .headingMd, .headingSm, .bodyLg, .bodyLgMedium, .bodyLgSemiBold, .bodyMd, .bodyMdMedium, .bodyMdSemiBold, .bodySm, .bodySmMedium, .bodySmSemiBold, .captionLg, .captionLgMedium, .captionLgSemiBold, .captionSm, .captionSmSemiBold
widgets.parameters: text: String (REQUIRED), textColor: Color?, textAlign: TextAlign = TextAlign.start, maxLines: int?, overflow: TextOverflow?, letterSpacing: double?, height: double?, decoration: TextDecoration?
widgets.example:
AppText.headingMd(text: 'Welcome Back', textColor: TextColors.colorText)

AppText.bodyMd(text: 'Enter your credentials', textColor: TextColors.colorTextSecondary)

AppText.captionLg(text: 'Forgot password?', textColor: TextColors.colorTextLink)

widgets.description: Checkbox input with custom styling.
widgets.parameters: value: bool? (REQUIRED), onChanged: ValueChanged<bool?>?, tristate: bool = false, isError: bool = false, size: double = 20, checkmarkSize: double = 14, activeColor: Color?, checkColor: Color?
widgets.example:
AppCheckBox(
  value: _rememberMe,
  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _rememberMe = value ?? false),
)

widgets.description: Radio button input. Generic type T for value/groupValue.
widgets.parameters: value: T (REQUIRED), groupValue: T (REQUIRED), onChanged: void Function(bool)?, borderWidth: double?, splashRadius: double?
widgets.example:
AppRadioButton<String>(
  value: 'option1',
  groupValue: selectedValue,
  onChanged: (selected) => setState(() => selectedValue = 'option1'),
)

widgets.description: Toggle switch component.
widgets.parameters: value: bool (REQUIRED), onChanged: void Function(bool)?, activeColor: Color?, activeTrackColor: Color?, inactiveTrackColor: Color?, thumbColor: Color?

widgets.description: SVG icon renderer. Requires flutter_svg package.
widgets.parameters: svgIconPath: String (REQUIRED), width: double? = 16, height: double? = 16, colorFilter: ColorFilter?, onTap: VoidCallback?, fit: BoxFit = BoxFit.contain
widgets.example:
AppIcon(
  svgIconPath: 'assets/svg/email.svg',
  width: 24,
  height: 24,
  colorFilter: ColorFilter.mode(IconColors.colorIcon, BlendMode.srcIn),
)

widgets.description: Badge for status indicators and labels. Has PRIVATE default constructor — use .small or .medium ONLY.
widgets.parameters: textLabel: String?, badgeType: AppBadgeType = AppBadgeType.defaultBadge, isStrong: bool = false, svgIconPath: String?, width: double?, borderRadius: double?
widgets.example:
AppBadge.small(
  textLabel: 'New',
  badgeType: AppBadgeType.info,
)

AppBadge.medium(
  textLabel: 'Active',
  badgeType: AppBadgeType.success,
